info.title: Overgoal Match API v1
info.summary: Client-agnostic contract for the Overgoal playable match.
info.description: Match API v1 describes the durable, authenticated owner-bound match service and Auth Boundary v1 routes. The server retains root-relative v1 paths for compatibility. See docs/contracts/match-api-v1.md.

MatchApiVersion.description: Contract major selected by the server. Required in M1; absent from the M0 prototype.

MatchAuthProfile.description: Authenticated authorization profile selected by the server.

RequestId.description: Bounded request correlation identifier accepted or generated by the server.

Traceparent.description: Server span in W3C trace context format.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the caller may retry.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the authenticated principal, operation, and target. M1 must require it on state-changing match commands and replay the first completed response for an identical retry.

CreateMatchIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
CreateMatchIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to createMatch and the authenticated principal. Exact retries replay the original 201 response.

StartMatchIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
StartMatchIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to startMatch, the authenticated principal, and the target match. Exact retries replay the original response.

StartMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
StartMatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision. A stale start command returns MATCH_REVISION_CONFLICT without mutation.

MatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
MatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision. M1 must reject stale commands with MATCH_REVISION_CONFLICT.

ProcessActionIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ProcessActionIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to processMatchAction and the target match. Exact retries replay the first completed response.

ProcessActionMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
ProcessActionMatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision for the pending action.

MatchProgress.description: The next authoritative minute or earlier stop: a playable scene, halftime, or full time.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON or a prototype-era invalid lifecycle transition.

Unauthorized.description: M1 authenticated profile only: no usable principal or session.

Forbidden.description: M1 authenticated profile only: public transport-policy denial.

Conflict.description: Lifecycle, stale-action, revision, idempotency, or caller-scoped Legend mapping conflict. M1 guarantee.

ValidationError.description: Syntactically valid JSON that violates the request or current-scene decision schema.

RateLimited.description: The bounded per-process request policy rejected the request before its handler ran.

NotReady.description: The process is draining or durable storage is unavailable.

Identifier.description: Opaque identifier. Consumers must not infer UUID structure.

SimulationSeed.description: Canonical match seed serialized as an opaque string to avoid numeric precision loss. M1 must persist it and derive all authoritative randomness from it.

Coordinate.description: Authoritative normalized pitch coordinate in the field-coordinate-system/1 axes.

FieldCoordinateSystem.description: One canonical system for pitch geometry, players, ball ground projection, labels, collision overlays, and every x/y/z flight point.

FieldSequence.description: Backend-authored anchor and normalized crop locked for the submitted field-state input/playback/result sequence. It contains no viewport pixels.

requested_seed.description: Optional client compatibility metadata. It is never an authoritative entropy source.

engine_version.description: match-engine/7 supports live mutation. Persisted match-engine/1 through match-engine/6 state is read/replay-only; live mutation fails as 409 INVALID_MATCH_TRANSITION.

CurrentMatchContext.description: Closed current field context. MatchContext remains the historical engine v1-v6 read schema.

CurrentMatchMetadata.description: Current match metadata with a closed possession-chain context when present.

LegacyMatch.description: Persisted read/replay match metadata for frozen engines 1 through 6.

CurrentMatch.description: Live engine/7 match metadata with authoritative tactics and every embedded context on the closed current contract.

team_id.description: Stable team identity supplied for every current field player.

team_side.description: Authoritative side, independent of role or display label.

collision_shape.description: Authoritative metric body/receive geometry used by contact resolution.

radius_m.description: Horizontal interception radius in metres before adding ball radius.

height_m.description: Inclusive authoritative contact reach in metres; standard players and walls use exactly 2.0 m.

receive_radius_m.description: Forgiving teammate receive radius in metres before adding ball radius.

LaneTracePoint.description: A lane input timestamp. The required first point selects starting_lane at second 0; every later point starts movement toward lane at at_second and never applies before that timestamp.

side.description: Decision-contact compatibility alias; team_side remains the canonical field ownership key.

CurrentFieldState.description: Closed current field payload. FieldState remains the historical read schema for engines 1 through 6.

PendingActionSource.description: Authoritative cause of the playable pause: a generated simulation event, a same-minute decision follow-up, or a next-minute continuation of retained possession.

CurrentPendingActionBase.description: Current submitted-action payload with closed context and embedded state.

CurrentPendingAction.description: Current pending action. Scene choice rules remain shared while authoritative context/state are strict.

FlightPoint.description: Sampled authoritative ball-center point. x/y use the submitted field state's normalized axes, z is metres above the pitch, and t is seconds from contact.

x.description: Normalized pitch x; may pass slightly outside 0..100 until the full ball crosses a boundary.

y.description: Normalized pitch y; may pass slightly outside 0..100 until the full ball crosses a boundary or goal line.

z.description: Ball-center height in metres, including the 0.11 m resting radius.

CurrentDecisionResult.description: Current decision result with strict authoritative player and follow-up context payloads.

LegacyMatchOperationPlayback.description: Historical operation playback for frozen engines 1 through 6.

CurrentMatchOperationPlayback.description: Current operation playback. Every duplicated authoritative state/context path uses a closed schema.

LegacyMatchOperationReceipt.description: Historical operation receipt selected by a containing engine/1-5 response.

CurrentMatchOperationReceipt.description: Current operation receipt selected by a containing current response.

MatchOperationPlayback.description: Historical standalone playback schema. Current responses select CurrentMatchOperationPlayback through engine_version.

MatchOperationReceipt.description: Historical standalone receipt schema. Current responses select CurrentMatchOperationReceipt through engine_version.

MatchProgressResponse.description: Version-selected progress graph. Engine/7 cannot fall through the legacy field/context alternatives.

seed.description: Optional client compatibility metadata recorded as requested_seed. The server generates the authoritative match seed.

DecisionSeedHint.description: Compatibility/replay metadata supplied by the client. The runtime records but does not use this value for authoritative outcomes; M1 replay derives outcomes from the durable match seed and ordered action identity.

KickContact.description: First authoritative ball contact. PLAYER/GOALKEEPER player_id identifies the exact field player whose declared collision shape admitted contact at at.z.

AutomaticKickFollowUp.description: Authoritative teammate shot after a controlled pass. The first flight_path point restarts time at t=0 and its x/y/z coordinates must equal the parent DecisionResult final_point.

flight_path.description: Shot-local trajectory whose first point is t=0 at the exact x/y/z of the incoming pass final_point.

CurrentKickResolution.description: Current kick resolution with a closed scene follow-up context.

lane_trace.description: Movement-input timestamps. The final selected lane is held through second 8 without an endpoint marker; each movement must finish within the advertised duration.

MatchSnapshotResponse.description: Version-selected snapshot graph. Engine/7 cannot validate through permissive historical state/context schemas.
